input.quote: d. Ownership. Notwithstanding the license granted under section 2.1, TrueLink retains all of its ownership and license rights in the Interface.
input.rationale: The only ownership provision (§ 2(d)) runs one way: TrueLink retains ownership of the Interface, and no clause anywhere gives us ownership of, or an enduring licence to, what TrueLink creates for us. The Support Services results are merely deemed "Client Proprietary Information" for confidentiality purposes (p0065), which is not ownership, and § 13 confirms Client ownership only of domains and Client Content "[i]n case of discontinued Service" (p0078). Our § 2 licence is limited to use of the Interface, is not perpetual, irrevocable or sublicensable, and terminates with the Agreement (p0022, p0028), so the bargain fails the fallback licence elements as well as the preferred ownership elements, and there is no statement that we retain rights in our content and borrower/loan data. We have therefore inserted a short § 2(e) supplying our ownership and TrueLink's assignment of work product, a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to any TrueLink IP embedded in it, retention of our data, and no joint ownership; TrueLink's retained ownership of the Interface (already at our preferred position for vendor pre-existing IP) is untouched. Separately noted, not flagged: § 8(d) grants TrueLink a broad licence to narrowly defined archived Credit Data, which is a licence rather than an assignment and does not displace our retained rights.

proposal.summary: Add Client ownership of work product, assignment, licence back to embedded TrueLink IP, Client Data retention and no joint ownership
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 2(d) only records TrueLink's ownership of the Interface, so we have added the customer-side half: we own and TrueLink assigns the work product created for us (including Support Services results), we get a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to any TrueLink IP embedded in it, we retain our content and borrower data, and nothing is jointly owned. TrueLink's ownership of the Interface is unaffected.

ops.text: Client Work Product and Client Data. Client owns all deliverables and work product created for Client under this Agreement, including all results of the Support Services, and TrueLink hereby assigns all right, title and interest therein to Client. TrueLink grants Client a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free license to any TrueLink Intellectual Property embedded in such deliverables and work product. Client retains all right, title and interest in Client Content, Client Intellectual Property and all borrower and loan data. No intellectual property will be jointly owned by the parties.
